narr: A ridge of high pressure was centered over the Four Corners and brought deep monsoon moisture into Arizona. A decaying complex of thunderstorms over northern Mexico also helped to increase moisture across the area.
ev: The USGS stream gauge along the Agua Fria River near Humboldt (AFHA3) reported a 7.86 foot rise starting at around 700 PM, peaking at around 9 PM, and retrning to near normal at around 1 AM. The Agua Fria River gauge near Mayer (AFMA03) began to rise at around 100 AM, rose 2.5 feet by 200 AM, and the dropped to near normal at 1200 PM on the 15th.||There was a Swift water rescue at 835 PM off of Bradshaw Mountain Road in the Quailwood Subdivision (Agua Fria River). Vehicle in the water with two occupants. Report from spotter on social media.
